levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب

notes: two taḥwīl branches meet at حضين; the matn after them («فجلده علي وقال جلد رسول الله») is written once and is the shared tail
«علي» is the last link: the report relays his words (rule 6); Uthman's words («قال لعلي دونك») are in the scene
the two branches write حضين differently (الرقاشي in one): both kept as written
